translations.web: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, which would make him unclean. I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD.
translations.asv: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat, to defile himself therewith: I am Jehovah.
